title: Signature
description: Detached Ed25519 proof over EPR canonical bytes. Source of truth: EPR atom, self-notarized via content-address (CIDv1 dag-cbor sha256) + Ed25519 signature. Canonical CBOR bytes + detached signature is the authoritative form. Category A — notarized; notarization mechanism is content-derived CID + signer proof (not DHT). JSON wire format: CIDs serialize as integer arrays (byte representation of the CIDv1 multihash binary form, via the cid crate serde-codec feature); signature bytes serialize as integer arrays (64 bytes for Ed25519), produced by serde_bytes.

signer.description: CIDv1 of the issuer's Agent EPR, serialized as a byte array (serde-codec feature of the cid crate).

algorithm.description: Signing algorithm identifier. Only ed25519 is accepted.

signature.description: Raw Ed25519 signature bytes (exactly 64 bytes), serialized as an integer array by serde_bytes.
